paragraphs: A composition about rain arrested in a body. Inside every faceted lozenge, gold sparks shimmer — drops caught at the moment of falling and left there for good.
Lozenges of differing size hang at differing heights: the swarm is deep and layered and reassembles as you walk around it, like a kaleidoscope.

By day it is smoky gold — a rare, adult register: the composition looks expensive and restrained at once, read through faceting and inner sparks. In the evening light burns inside every crystal and the facets hand it out to the space in sharp warm highlights — the swarm begins to throw light across the walls.
LC0531.whereItWorks: Living rooms, dining rooms, studies, lobbies, reception rooms. The layered swarm requires height and reads as you walk around it.
LC0531.style: Art Deco and jewelled Art Nouveau: the smoky stone as a gem. The message is restrained and expensive — a piece for an interior with adult taste.
LC0531.madeToOrder: The number of crystals, their sizes and the density of the swarm are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about the sun caught in the flesh. The glow sits right at the stalk of every fruit — where a real olive holds its stone. The light turns out to be inside, like a kernel.
Fruits ranging from soft lime to deep emerald hang in clusters among gold leaves twisted by the wind. The clusters gather loosely: a dense harvest at the centre, occasional drops at the edges.

By day it is the Mediterranean in pure form: gold foliage, green fruit, a bubbled mass against the light. In the evening a warm point comes on inside every fruit and the cluster fills — the green turns succulent and the leaves pick up the reflected glow.
LC0532.whereItWorks: Above a dining table, in a winter garden, in a kitchen-dining room, in spaces that want the south. The loose cluster is assembled for a specific plan.
LC0532.style: Mediterranean classicism and Art Nouveau: the olive branch as the oldest of motifs. The message is warm and southern — a piece for an interior that loves the sun.
LC0532.madeToOrder: The number of fruits and leaves, the shades of green and the scale of the cluster are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about sunflowers looking for the sun. The flowers face in different directions — the bouquet has no front and is beautiful from any position, because every flower looks where it needs to.
Dozens of petals radiate from a mirrored chrome disc with a hemisphere core: the chrome at the centres adds a contemporary edge to the warm amber.

By day it is honey-coloured blooms with mirrored centres: the bubbled mass reads against the light, a warm and generous piece. In the evening the light burns behind the disc and pushes out between the petals, tracing each with a fiery contour — the flower glows around its edges rather than from within.
LC0533.whereItWorks: A dense crown above a round table or a scattering of flowers at differing heights in an entrance hall — the bouquet is assembled for the space. Having no front means it is viewed in the round.
LC0533.style: Art Nouveau and mid-century: the aster with a technical core. The message is warm and alive — a piece for an interior in a honey register.
LC0533.madeToOrder: The number of flowers, their diameters and the angle of tilt are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition in two scales. The architectural rigour of the blocks — and the weightless scattering of drops around it: the city and the rain work at the same time, and neither subordinates the other.
Blocks of green ribbed plates read as the quarters of a transparent city with warm windows inside; through them and around them falls a rain of thousands of faceted beads.

By day it is green volumes in a clear suspension — a piece read through quarters and ribbing, dense and graphic. In the evening light from the blocks reflects in the beads and the composition shimmers like a city on a rainy night: the windows burn and the rain blurs them.
LC0534.whereItWorks: Tall spaces — atriums, lobbies, grand staircases. A large statement piece: the rain is built downward and the blocks need volume around them.
LC0534.style: Urban modernism and Art Deco: the city as a formal motif. The message is large-scale — a piece for a building rather than for a room.
LC0534.madeToOrder: The number of blocks, the density of the rain and the tone of the plates are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about turning in different directions. Every element is twisted its own way, and the cloud seems alive, fluid, breathing — if the coils all ran the same way the piece would be mechanical.
Long spirals with a ribbed texture read as a curl of hair or as a shaving off a jeweller's bench. Clear and smoky intermixed add depth.

By day it is a cluster of twisted forms on gold cones: the composition reads through plasticity and the hatching of the ribbing. In the evening light enters from above and runs down the coils, flaring at every turn of the spiral — the curls light up along the spiral rather than all at once.
LC0535.whereItWorks: Above a dining table, in a stairwell, above a reception desk — wherever the composition is seen from the side and from below. The hanging cluster sets the lower boundary.
LC0535.style: Baroque in a minimal rendering and jewellery aesthetics: the curl without ornament. The message is expressive — a piece for an interior that needs character.
LC0535.madeToOrder: The number of curls, their lengths and the palette are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about the beginning of autumn. Smoky and pale leaves alternate, giving the cloud a depth and a weather that a uniform mass never has: the sky in the first days of autumn looks exactly like this.
Large leaves with the finest vein texture fall as a broad cloud, each on its own cable, each at its own turn. Gold cones at the top read as stalks from which the leaf has only just come away.

By day the texture makes the surface alive: light runs along the veins and every leaf gets a pattern of its own. In the evening the veins light from within — the canopy glows by its veining rather than by its plane.
LC0536.whereItWorks: As a cascade in a stairwell or as a broad wave above a long table. The composition is good at full extent: it needs either height or length.
LC0536.style: Art Nouveau and natural modern: the leaf as a classic motif. The message is warm and melancholy — a piece for an interior in a natural register.
LC0536.madeToOrder: The number of leaves, the balance of smoky to clear and the shape of the cloud are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a trace on ice. The ribbons wind in smooth spirals — the crests of waves, untied bows, the arcs left by a skater: a form with no beginning and no end, which the eye follows without stopping.
The rods stay almost colourless: all the expression is in movement and light, not a gram of decor.

By day it is a clear streamer in the air — a piece read through trajectory and with almost no mass. In the evening gold capsules woven into the ribbons ignite them from within at warm intervals: the light comes not as an unbroken line but as a dotted one — like a trace that shows and then does not.
LC0537.whereItWorks: Large spaces — atriums, double-height living rooms, lobbies where the streamer has somewhere to fly. The trajectory is designed for a specific volume.
LC0537.style: Contemporary sculptural installation: the line as the only material. The message is light and dynamic — a piece for a space that wants movement.
LC0537.madeToOrder: The length and trajectory of the ribbons and the number of coils and points of light are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a storm. Fan-shaped wings twist through space in swift spirals — the feathers of a firebird, or petals caught by the wind. The movement is taken to the limit: this is one of the brand's most temperamental pieces.
The colour works at the same limit: a deep ruby with not one softening shade.

By day it is red vortices with chrome cores — a dense colour read through the twist and the rod texture of the fans. In the evening capsules within ignite the fans with a deep garnet radiance and the space around is charged: the light does not illuminate, it heats.
LC0538.whereItWorks: Interiors that need character — restaurants, bars, art spaces, living rooms with a bold palette. Saturated red takes command of a room: neutral surfaces are needed nearby.
LC0538.style: Contemporary sculptural installation and theatrical aesthetics: colour and movement as a statement. The message is passionate — a piece for a space that is not afraid to be loud.
LC0538.madeToOrder: The spread of the vortex, the number of fans and the saturation of the red are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about frozen rain. The tubes descend in a dense cascade — jets caught by frost halfway down. The lower edge breathes: long and short alternate like the edge of melting ice.
Inside, a bubbled mass; outside, chrome tips: a cold, clean note held all the way through.

By day it is clear verticals with bubbles seen against the light — a piece read through rhythm and the ragged lower edge, strict and bright. In the evening thousands of bubbles flare along the whole length, and every tube turns into a column of radiance: the ice catches fire from within.
LC0540.whereItWorks: Stairwells and the zone above a kitchen island, where verticals read at full height; contemporary spaces with panoramic windows and spare finishes. The cascade is designed for the height.
LC0540.style: Contemporary minimalism and high-tech: cold as an aesthetic position. The message is clean and technical — a piece for an interior with no embellishment.
LC0540.madeToOrder: The number of tubes, their lengths and the format of the cascade are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a fragility that must not be over-lit. The light here does not dominate, it accompanies: fine gold drop-luminaires are dissolved through the flock and underline the contours without destroying the lightness. The author deliberately dims the source so as not to kill the image.
The butterflies — clear and smoky, with gold accents on the bodies — hover as a cloud on fine suspensions.

By day the wings catch daylight and pass it on: reflections fly from facet to facet, and the swarm comes alive at any movement of air. In the evening the drops trace the contours in warmth while the wings themselves stay clear — what glows is not the butterflies but the lines between them.
LC0541.whereItWorks: A dense swarm above a table, a sparse flock along a staircase, a vortex in an entrance hall — the size and the character of the flight are set at assembly. The composition adapts to any geometry.
LC0541.style: Art Nouveau and romantic modern: the butterfly as a classic motif of fragility. The message is light and poetic — a piece for an interior that does not want heaviness.
LC0541.madeToOrder: The number of butterflies, the palette of the wings and the shape of the cloud are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about light where the sun does not reach. Elongated cocoons with a cellular surface have grown in darkness: not one repeats another, as in nature. Between them, clear bubbles rise on cables.
The glow is calm and deep — the way organisms glow far down: not brightly but evenly.

By day it is white cellular forms with a clear suspension between them — a piece read through texture and the variety of the silhouettes. In the evening light passes through the half-transparent shell as a soft inner radiance, the bubbles catch it and rise as a glowing chain — a depth in which life itself is what glows.
LC0542.whereItWorks: Bedrooms, spas, bathrooms, rest areas — places where light should calm. The soft glow without glare suits long stays.
LC0542.style: Bio-design and marine modern: bioluminescence as a motif. The message is contemplative and quiet — a piece for an interior that immerses.
LC0542.madeToOrder: The number of cocoons, the density of the bubbles and the dimensions are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a fracture. Two black relief wings — the texture of split rock or the bark of an ancient tree, with gold veining along the edges of the breaks — open up the plane of a wall. Between them a strict vertical line of light: energy held inside the mass.
The object works with shadow and with pause: what matters here is not the wings but the gap between them.

By day it is a graphic sculpture on the wall: the black texture reads as relief, the gold veining traces the breaks. In the evening the gap lights up and the object becomes a glowing fracture with warmth seeping out of it — the mass stays dark and only the crack glows.
LC0543.whereItWorks: Spare interiors — hallways, studies, bedrooms with character, gallery walls. The dark texture asks for a pale background so the silhouette can read.
LC0543.style: Brutal opulence and minimalism: the fracture as a form. The message is strong and restrained — a piece for an interior for which one detail is enough.
LC0543.madeToOrder: The size, the finish of the wings and the colour temperature of the light are all made to order.

paragraphs: The same fracture at intimate size. One element, taken from the mass and hung on the wall at eye level — where the texture is seen close to and the slit of light reads not as a device but as a detail.
The reduction changes the tone of voice: a large composition impresses, a small one invites you closer. The piece is made for short distance.

By day it is a graphic object on the wall: the black texture of the breaks, the golden veins along the edges, nothing more. In the evening the slit lights up as a thin vertical and lays a soft warm halo on the wall around it — the mass stays dark, only the crack glows.
LC0543-1.whereItWorks: Entrance halls, corridors, bedrooms at the bedhead, studies. Solo as a single accent, or in a series — then a rhythm of fractures grows across the wall.
LC0543-1.style: Brutal luxe and minimalism: the break as form. The message is restrained — a piece for a wall that needs one detail only.
LC0543-1.madeToOrder: The size, the finish of the wings and the colour temperature are all made to order.

paragraphs: The same fracture, taken off the wall. The wings with their split-rock texture are released into the air and repeated — not one object but a mass: dozens of fractures at different heights, each with its own vertical slit of light.
The device stays the same — it is not the mass that glows but the crack — yet in the plural it reads differently: there it was a single pause, here it is their rhythm.

By day it is a dark sculptural field: the black texture reads as relief, the golden veins outline the breaks, the composition is dense and heavy to the eye. In the evening the slits light up through the whole depth of the mass, and the field turns into rock cracked in a hundred places — the light seeps from within while the volume itself stays mute.
LC0543-2.whereItWorks: Lobbies, restaurants, bars, private sitting rooms, gallery spaces. A dark mass asks for dark surroundings: against a light background the contrast stops working.
LC0543-2.style: Brutal luxe and contemporary sculpture: the fracture as a module. The message is strong — a piece for an interior with character.
LC0543-2.madeToOrder: The number of elements, the depth of the mass and the colour temperature are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition as a collection. Inside the large elements are gold ammonites in relief: ancient spirals of time enlarged by the faceting as by a lens. The piece is examined like the display case of a mineralogical museum assembled by a jeweller.
The faceting works as optics: it refracts, magnifies and animates the gold relief — the ammonites seem volumetric and almost in motion.

By day it is a cloud of faceted boulders with gold spirals inside — a piece read through refractions, and every element looks different depending on the angle. In the evening light circulates inside the facets, flaring on the ridges, and the ammonites emerge from the depth — time lit from inside the stone.
LC0544.whereItWorks: Living rooms, studies, lobbies, reception rooms, gallery spaces. The composition is examined close up: it is hung no higher than necessary.
LC0544.style: Jewelled Art Nouveau and natural aesthetics: the fossil as a gem. The message is collectorly — a piece for someone who values detail.
LC0544.madeToOrder: The number of elements, the number of ammonites and the scale of the cloud are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a bouquet of living and man-made flowers at once. Two characters of corolla — milky white and smoky clear — are gathered into one garland, and the difference between them is not immediately visible: the composition breathes on that contrast.
At the core of every flower is a mirrored sphere and a soft light.

By day the white corollas read through matte plasticity while the clear ones play on highlights and depth: an airy, almost weightless piece. In the evening the white ones glow evenly and softly, the clear ones let light pass right through and flare — one and the same flower behaves in two ways. The moment of flowering, extended for good.
LC0545.whereItWorks: Living rooms, dining rooms, bedrooms, wedding halls, reception rooms. The garland is calculated for the length of the zone and hung at a level where the contrast between the two corollas is visible.
LC0545.style: Art Nouveau and romantic classicism: flowering as subject. The message is tender — a piece for a light interior.
LC0545.madeToOrder: The composition of the garland, the balance of white to smoky and the scale are all made to order.

paragraphs: The same bouquet, taken larger. The corollas are scaled up, the garland is loosened, and air appears between the flowers — the piece stops being a dense line and becomes a sparse branch where every flower reads on its own.

The contrast of two characters is kept: the milky white ones hold a matte calm, the smoky clear ones give depth and highlight. In the loosened arrangement that contrast is seen at once rather than discovered on closer looking.

By day it is large corollas in the air: matte beside clear, the piece read through the modelling of the petals and the gaps between them. In the evening the white ones glow evenly, the clear ones let the light through and flare, and the chain of flowers begins to shimmer every other one — a flowering that has a rhythm.
LC0545-1.whereItWorks: Sitting rooms, dining rooms, bedrooms, reception rooms, boutiques. A loosened arrangement asks for length rather than height: the composition is built along the zone.
LC0545-1.style: Art Nouveau and romantic classicism: flowering as the subject. The message is tender and bright — a piece for an interior in a calm palette.
LC0545-1.madeToOrder: The number of corollas, the spacing between them and the balance of white and smoke are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about suspension. This is not a chandelier in the usual sense but a light environment: the movement of air, an accumulation of particles, a suspension that has caught the sunset. Hundreds of crumpled leaves hover as a dense swarm, with gold drops flaring among them here and there.
The composition constantly changes in perception: as the viewer moves the swarm reassembles, and at different brightnesses it changes density.

By day the smoky and amber elements read as a mass without detail: a dense warm cloud living off reflections. In the evening the occasional gold drops light up between them and the swarm acquires depth — what glows is not the elements but the gaps.
LC0546.whereItWorks: Where there is time to look — above a long table, in a lounge, in a meeting room with a high ceiling. The dense swarm requires volume.
LC0546.style: Contemporary sculptural installation: an environment instead of an object. The message is contemplative — a piece for a space where people linger.
LC0546.madeToOrder: The density of the swarm, the palette and the dimensions are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a reef raised from the sea floor. Two kinds of element form a colony: openwork blue-violet nets, like the fans of gorgonians, and white textured cones with a cellular surface, like colonies of polyps. Between them, cold points of light — plankton.

The composition is built on the contrast of dense against clear: the nets let the gaze pass right through, the cones hold the volume. From every angle the reef reassembles, opening new gaps and shadows.

By day it is a marine palette — ultramarine, lilac, white: a piece fresh and deep at once, read through openwork and texture. In the evening the points between the elements shimmer as suspension, the nets show through and the cones stay dark — the colony turns out to be at depth.
LC0547.whereItWorks: Spas, pools, bathrooms, living rooms in a marine register, children's rooms. The openwork structure steals no light and suits shaded zones.
LC0547.style: Marine modern and bio-design: the reef as a form with no author. The message is natural — a piece for an interior beside water.
LC0547.madeToOrder: The composition of the reef, the balance of the colours and the size of the colony are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about lace turned by the sea, and about what grows through it. White plates with an organic perforation hold the structure while cascades of ruby elements push through them — the piece shows two natures at once: the bony and the living.
The contrast of white against saturated red makes the composition ceremonial and faintly mysterious.

By day it is white lace with red clusters: the bubbled mass of the ruby elements reads against the light, the perforation as graphic work. In the evening the light passes softly through the clusters, igniting them a deep red, and seeps through the perforation as warm points — the white becomes a sieve, the red a core.
LC0548.whereItWorks: Spaces with character — wine rooms, restaurants, living rooms with a dark palette, bars. Saturated red asks for quiet surroundings.
LC0548.style: Marine Art Nouveau and dark luxe: coral and ruby as a pair. The message is dramatic — a piece for an interior with a mood.
LC0548.madeToOrder: The ratio of plates to clusters, the depth of the red and the scale are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a form between three things. The matte mantle reads as a calla flower, as a sail and as the wing of a ray — the author does not specify, because what they have in common matters more than the differences: all three glide.
Every element is curved its own way: the shoal lives, dives, turns. Gold winding stems rule the composition with a fine live graphic, like weed in a current.

By day it is white mantles on gold lines — a piece read through the plasticity of the curves and the graphic of the stems. In the evening the points at the tips of the stems light up, the matte whiteness glows evenly and without glare, and the gold goes into shadow: what remains are glowing figures gliding through the dark.
LC0549.whereItWorks: Above a table, in a stairwell, in a double-height entrance hall. The composition has no principal angle — it is beautiful from everywhere and is placed where people walk around it.
LC0549.style: Marine modern and Art Nouveau: gliding as subject. The message is calm and plastic — a piece for an interior that loves a line.
LC0549.madeToOrder: The number of figures, the trajectory of the shoal and the scale are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about an inverted flowerbed. Greenery above, flowering at the tips: the garden is hung roots up, and the leaves reach downward like shoots through water.
Every orchid is a small glowing jewel; the green tier adds depth and sets off the whiteness.

By day it is a graceful botanical installation: green leaves above white flowers, a piece read through its two tiers and their contrast. In the evening the light lifts the petals carefully from within without destroying the fragility of the form, while the green tier stays dark — only the lower edge glows, like a flowering rim.
LC0550.whereItWorks: Above a table, in a stairwell, in a winter garden, in a reception room. The two-tier assembly requires height: without it the tiers merge.
LC0550.style: Art Nouveau and botanical modern: the orchid as a motif of refinement. The message is refined — a piece for an interior with fine taste.
LC0550.madeToOrder: The number of flowers and leaves and the height and shape of the garden are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a moment that changes along with the viewer. From different angles the piece reads differently: now a current, now a flowering, now a firework stopped at its peak. No one reading is the principal one — the author leaves them all.
Clear relief fans with a fine inner texture are gathered into a layered cascade; at the core of each is a glossy gold sphere, a point of jewel precision.

By day the composition reads close up through the texture of the relief and from a distance through the overall movement of the cascade: two scales of perception in one piece. In the evening light slides along the folds, breaks up in the relief and gathers as highlights on the gold — every fan becomes a separate impulse of light, and together they give a living crystalline structure.
LC0551.whereItWorks: Living rooms, dining rooms, lobbies, stairwells. The layered cascade requires height and reads from a distance.
LC0551.style: Art Deco and contemporary sculpture: the fold and the sphere as the entire vocabulary. The message is formal — a piece for an interior that greets.
LC0551.madeToOrder: The shape of the cascade, the number of fans and the height are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a rising current. The petals are arrested in free flight, each with its own curve, turn and height; together they gather into a spatial whirlpool where rhythm, pause and depth are what matter.
This composition needs no light source to be bright: white enamel gives the purity, gold on the inner side of some elements gives warmth and weight.

By day the vortex lives on daylight: the white gloss reflects it softly, the gold reverses flare in the depth as precious accents, and the composition reads from below, from the side, from the stairs — a new frame every time. In the evening, under directed light, the gold catches fire more sharply while the white stays calm — the vortex acquires a rhythm of temperature.
LC0552.whereItWorks: Stairwells, double-height entrance halls, living rooms, reception rooms — wherever the composition is visible from several points. It requires no wiring but gains from directed light.
LC0552.style: Contemporary sculpture and Art Deco: movement instead of ornament. The message is light and formal — a piece for an interior that wants volume without weight.
LC0552.madeToOrder: The scale of the vortex, the number of petals and the share of gold ones are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a balance of opposites. The white glossy boat-shapes open with a soft glow from within; the chrome ones work by pure reflection, breaking an interior into highlights. Softness and cold shine gathered into one form.
The cloud is dense and low; light passes between the surfaces and is reflected back and forth in the facets.

By day the chrome elements gather the room while the white ones hold a quiet background: the cloud seems to reassemble slowly as you walk past. In the evening the white ones light from within while the chrome ones go on only reflecting — and the piece separates for good into two parts sounding together.
LC0553.whereItWorks: Living rooms, dining rooms, meeting rooms, lobbies. The low cloud requires no great height and suits medium ceilings.
LC0553.style: Contemporary minimalism and Art Deco: two behaviours of light as a device. The message is restrained — a piece for an interior that loves a nuance.
LC0553.madeToOrder: The size and density of the cloud and the ratio of white to chrome are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a stroke of the brush. Fine drawn-out forms read as feathers or as the traces of quick movements — a gesture rather than an object. Each with its own curve and its own character.
Golden capsules sit on the elements as tips: they add rhythm, warmth and points for the eye to settle on.

By day it is a layered flock of clear strokes — a piece read through movement and with almost no mass. In the evening the gold tips light up, the clear forms stay invisible, and what remains in the air is a single dotted line of movement — swift, light, effortless.
LC0554.whereItWorks: Above a table, in an entrance hall, along a staircase, in a meeting room. The layering requires a view from the side — the composition is not hung high.
LC0554.style: Calligraphic aesthetics and contemporary minimalism: the gesture instead of the form. The message is light and precise — a piece for an interior that values a line.
LC0554.madeToOrder: The number of elements, the spread of the flock and the density are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about an enfilade. Every element works as an arch through which the next one is visible: the composition is built on depth and rhythm rather than on density. The gaze travels inward, as through a run of openings in an old city.
Warm vertical capsules strengthen the architectural association — windows lit at sunset.

By day it is a clear enfilade: the upward-reaching silhouettes read through overlay and depth, a light and all but weightless piece. In the evening light passes through the mass softly and diffusely, and the composition does not dazzle but sets a mood — an Eastern evening, shadow and gold.
LC0555.whereItWorks: Living rooms, lobbies, dining rooms, reception rooms, restaurants. The depth reads from the side: the composition is hung at eye level rather than up under the ceiling.
LC0555.style: Eastern classicism and Art Deco: the arch as a decorative motif. The message is warm and atmospheric — a piece for an interior with an Eastern note.
LC0555.madeToOrder: The number of arches, the depth of the layers and the scale are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition with a plot. Out of a wave a flock of birds flies — the moment when the sea lets the sky go. The piece has a direction and a breath: this is one of the brand's most cinematic compositions.
Turquoise ribbons woven of the finest tubes curve into the crests of waves or into mountain ridges; points of warm light are scattered along their edges.

By day, from different angles, you read now waves, now wings, now a mountain range — the piece changes its plot along with the viewer. In the evening the edges light up warm, the blue birds go into shadow, and an aurora over water remains: what glows is the boundary, not the mass.
LC0556.whereItWorks: Architectural scale — atriums, lobbies, stair spaces several floors high, panoramic shopfronts. The composition is designed for a specific volume.
LC0556.style: Contemporary sculptural installation and marine modern: narrative as a genre. The message is epic — a piece for a building that wants a story.
LC0556.madeToOrder: The length of the wave, the number of birds and the palette are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about water arrested mid-fall. The contour holds a strict geometry — the tubes rise in a bundle and finish in smooth arches; the drops inside break it softly and naturally.
Order and its breaking work as a pair: without the arches the drops would be random, without the drops the arches would be empty.

By day it is gold arches with clear twisted drops: the bubbles read against the light, a rhythmic and composed piece. In the evening light passes through the drop and fills it with an inner radiance, while highlights run down the tubes toward the base — the light quite literally flows down the structure.
LC0558.whereItWorks: Living rooms, bedrooms, reception rooms, studies. It takes little space and gathers a whole room around it. Related to the LC0567 wall light — together they give one language of light for walls and floor.
LC0558.style: Art Deco and contemporary classic: the arch and the drop as a classic pairing. The message is elegant — a piece for an interior with poise.
LC0558.madeToOrder: The height, the number of drops and the finish of the tubes are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a flame that does not burn out. A cold base and a hot top — the whole object is built on that contrast: a technical, almost architectural base and a living organic crown.
A bundle of polished rods rises as a strict column, and at the top amber tongues with bubbles open out, gathered into a single ascending form.

By day it is chrome and amber: a strict vertical with a warm cap, a piece read through the contrast of two temperatures. In the evening the light inside is reflected over and over between the tongues, and the flame burns steadily, without one movement — a fire from which time has been taken away.
LC0559.whereItWorks: Solo beside an armchair, in a pair or a trio — and then the floor lamps become an avenue of fires: a rhythm for an entrance hall, a staircase or a winter garden.
LC0559.style: Industrial luxury and organic Art Nouveau: engineering below, nature above. The message is strong — a piece for an interior with character.
LC0559.madeToOrder: The height, the finish of the rods and the tone of the flame are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a shoot that has broken through a column. The stems set a strict vertical rhythm, and a clear twisted form appears inside it — like movement arrested where it has no business being.
The proportions are calibrated on growth: the drawn-out vertical emphasises the upward movement, and placing the forms at different levels creates an inner rhythm.

By day it is a bundle of gold stems with clear sails at the top: the bubbles in the mass read against the light, a strict and light piece. In the evening light burns at the heart of every sail, the bubbles flare as a constellation, and the clear mass throws live highlights onto the tubes — the strict column begins to breathe.
LC0560.whereItWorks: The corners of a living room, the zone beside a window, wall piers, reception rooms. The vertical takes little floor area and works both as a source and as a sculpture.
LC0560.style: Organic Art Nouveau and architectural minimalism: growth within order. The message is alive — a piece for an interior that loves contrast.
LC0560.madeToOrder: The height, the finish of the stems and the number of clear elements are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a chase. Half the petals glow, half are faceted polished chrome, and around the circle they chase one another: light after shine, shine after light. The wall is set in motion.
The spiral is twisted so that the eye finds no beginning: the circle has no point of entry.

By day the object lives on sculptural plasticity: the chrome gathers the interior into shards of reflection while the pale petals hold the purity. In the evening a second life begins — a warm glow around the mirrored cores turns the composition into an interior jewel.
LC0561.whereItWorks: Accent walls — entrance halls, living rooms, reception rooms, reception desks. Objects like this do not fill a space, they shape it: they set a rhythm and gather attention.
LC0561.style: Contemporary Art Deco and kinetic art: rotation as subject. The message is expressive — a piece that starts the conversation about an interior.
LC0561.madeToOrder: The diameter of the vortex, the number of petals and the balance of light to chrome are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about repetition as rhythm. Every module is a separate graphic brushstroke; together they give repetition, symmetry and contrast. The light here is part of the visual rhythm rather than a function.
The column is assembled from "grain" modules in glossy enamel: in the white version, snowy purity in a chrome setting; in the gold one, a warm shine.

By day the gloss reflects the surroundings and gives the piece a futurist edge: the floor lamp reads as a sculpture living on borrowed light. In the evening a soft glow leaves the core of every module and balances the audacity of the form — the column turns warm while staying graphic.
LC0562.whereItWorks: Solo as a sculpture beside an armchair, or in a pair framing a sofa group with a symmetrical rhythm. The piece speaks loudly — it needs an interior ready for that.
LC0562.style: Pop art and retro-futurism: the module instead of the ornament, gloss instead of texture. The message is audacious — a piece for an interior with character.
LC0562.madeToOrder: The height, the finish and the number of modules are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a pen drawing. The light travels along the edges of the folds and gathers into a shimmer of contour: the silhouette of the wall light is drawn in light rather than flooded with it.
Two corrugated smoky fans meet on a chrome sphere — the point of attraction for the whole composition; gold sparks are scattered through the mass of the fans.

By day the undulating relief makes the surface alive: with every step the reflections reassemble, the gold inclusions flare and fade, and the depth of the smoky tone opens anew. In the evening the edges of the folds light up and the piece becomes a contour drawing on the wall — the volume goes, the line remains.
LC0563.whereItWorks: Hallways, living rooms, bedrooms, corridors. In a paired version two wall lights enter into a dialogue and set one rhythm on a wall — no longer a luminaire but a wall sculpture.
LC0563.style: Art Deco and contemporary sculpture: the fold and the sphere as the entire vocabulary. The message is expressive — a piece for a wall that needs an accent.
LC0563.madeToOrder: The execution of the fans, their number and the composition on the wall are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about living matter. A band of mirrored gold with ragged edges is stitched with cells — the skeleton of a sea sponge; inside the cells sit milky bubbles, like air caught in rock. It seems the structure is still growing on the wall.
The light is its breathing: it burns inside and comes out through the openings.

By day it is a gold relief with milky inserts: a piece read through cellular structure and a ragged contour, tactile and complex. In the evening light leaves through the openings as warm patches and sharp gold highlights — the coral begins to glow by its pores.
LC0564.whereItWorks: Singly as a concentrated art accent or in a series — and then the coral spreads across the wall as a colony. Entrance halls, living rooms, spa areas, reception rooms.
LC0564.style: Bio-design and marine modern: the sponge as a form with no author. The message is natural and tactile — a piece for an interior with character.
LC0564.madeToOrder: The size, the configuration of the cells and the number of elements in a series are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a branch growing up a wall. The flowers open in different directions, the trumpet stems fly apart in a free graphic — the vertical reads as a plant rather than as a composition.
Among the white flowers there is one smoky and clear: a shadow in the bouquet that gives it depth. Without it the branch would be flat.

By day it is fine plasticity and chrome graphic work: white flowers with a live uneven edge read as anemones or poppies, and the smoky one works as a hollow. In the evening a soft light leaves the mirrored hemispheres at the cores and settles as haloes around every corolla — warm islands of light appear on the wall.
LC0565.whereItWorks: Wall piers, walls beside a bedhead, corridors, stair flights, hallways. The vertical branch sits on a narrow surface where a wide wall light would not fit.
LC0565.style: Art Nouveau and contemporary classic: the branch as a classic wall motif. The message is alive — a piece for an interior that loves botany.
LC0565.madeToOrder: The number of flowers, the inclusion of smoky accents and the height are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about ascent. The cascade narrows downward and the piece reads as a current slowly rising, drawing the light up behind it — the movement runs against expectation.

Cold chrome and warm amber work off each other: the contour rules strict verticals and arcs, the drops fill them with a dense glow. Each is twisted its own way — there are no two identical movements in a current.

By day it is chrome loops with amber drops inside: a piece read through the graphic of the contour and the colour of the drops. In the evening the drops fill with honey, the chrome goes into shadow, and what remains is a single stream of warm points rising from the bottom up.
LC0566.whereItWorks: Vertical spaces — stairwells, double-height entrance halls, atriums, where upward movement can be shown at full height.
LC0566.style: Contemporary Art Deco and sculptural modernism: the rising current as subject. The message is optimistic — a piece for a vertical that leads the eye upward.
LC0566.madeToOrder: The height of the cascade, the number of elements and the ratio of chrome to amber are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a line written in one movement. A vertical loop of polished gold holds two clear drops inside it — the contour sets the geometry, the drop breaks it. The object lives in that balance.
In the mass of the drops there is a scattering of air bubbles.

By day it is a gold line with clear forms inside: a piece read through contour and bubbles against the light, graphic and light. In the evening segments of light lift the drops from above and below, they catch fire from within and the bubbles flare as a constellation — the loop stays dark and what is inside it glows.
LC0567.whereItWorks: Singly beside a mirror or a bedhead, in a pair flanking a portal, in a rhythmic series along a corridor or a staircase. The vertical accent takes little wall space.
LC0567.style: Art Deco and contemporary classic: the loop and the drop as a pair. The message is elegant — a piece for an interior with poise.
LC0567.madeToOrder: The finish of the contour, the character of the drops and the height are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a bouquet that will never go over. Every flower is open in its own direction — the moment of flowering fixed at its best phase.

The composition is built on a contrast of textures: the milky surface gives softness and an even glow, the clear blue gives depth and highlights, the gold spheres at the cores give precision and rhythm.

By day it is blue with milk on gold: everything reassembles as you walk around — open bowls, the ribs of the folds, flashes off the spheres. In the evening the milky ones glow evenly, the blue ones let light pass right through and fill with depth, and the spheres reflect their neighbours: the bouquet begins to shift colour from within.
LC0568.whereItWorks: Dining rooms, living rooms, spa areas, reception rooms, wedding halls. Bowls facing in different directions mean it is viewed in the round: the composition is placed at the centre of a zone.
LC0568.style: Art Nouveau and marine modern: the horn as a flower. The message is fresh and festive — a piece for a light interior.
LC0568.madeToOrder: The number of flowers, the balance of blue to milk and the scale are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about an object of the inner circle. The piece lives on a table, a console or a shelf, at arm's length — where the texture is visible and the character can be heard. This is not an accent for a room but a companion.

The folds radiate from the centre in uneven rays — the skirt of a jellyfish or a gramophone horn compressed at the moment of sound. In the smoky version the surface is deep and mirrored; in the version with gold inclusions, thousands of warm particles shimmer in the mass.

By day the object changes constantly with the angle of view and with whatever is happening around it: every facet catches a highlight of its own. In the evening light leaves the core and spreads through the folds from within — the relief appears entire and the object becomes a glowing flower.
LC0569.whereItWorks: A desk, a console in a hallway, a shelf in a living room, a bedside table. The compact format requires no ceiling space and no wiring.
LC0569.style: Art Deco and marine modern: the horn as a form. The message is intimate — a piece for a personal space.
LC0569.madeToOrder: The execution, the finish of the core and the calibre are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about rain under wind. Here the rain does not fall straight down but at a slant: the elements hang with a slight diagonal offset, and the gold tubes bend into drawn-out loops — the trajectories of drops ruled through the air.
The contour fixes an instant of movement, and inside every loop is a clear drop twisted by its flight.

By day it is gold graphic work with clear drops inside — a piece read through trajectories and the diagonal. In the evening segments of light on the tubes lift the drop along its whole length and it shimmers as though catching the last ray before a storm: an arrested downpour.
LC0570.whereItWorks: As a horizontal stream above a table or as a dense storm cloud in an entrance hall — the format adapts, the sensation stays. The direction of the wind is set at assembly.
LC0570.style: Art Deco and natural Art Nouveau: rain as a classic motif of movement. The message is dynamic — a piece for an interior that does not stand still.
LC0570.madeToOrder: The direction of the stream, its density and the number of drops are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a molecule. Amber bubbles join polished spheres into clusters — bonds, chains, points of attraction: an enlarged fragment of matter, alive and a little chaotic.
The piece has both scientific precision and artistic freedom: the elements look random and assemble into a considered formula.

By day it is warm volumes with cold chrome nodes — a piece read through structure and reflections. In the evening light comes on inside the amber volumes, the mirrored inner surface turns every bubble into a small furnace with warm reflections, and the chrome between them stays cold: the molecule breathes on contrast.
LC0571.whereItWorks: Living rooms, lobbies, meeting rooms, showrooms, lofts. The clusters spread through a volume — the composition is designed for a specific space.
LC0571.style: Scientific aesthetics and mid-century: the structure of matter as a form. The message is intellectual — a piece for an interior with an idea.
LC0571.madeToOrder: The number of clusters, their make-up and their spread through the space are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about nature never repeating itself. That principle is built into the piece itself: every rod is like the section of a mineral, with its own veining, streaks, depth and direction of texture. Two identical elements do not physically exist.
The rods are gathered into black collars and hang as a dense field with a live lower contour. The collars hold the rhythm like a bass line under a melody.

By day it is a collection of sections: close up the piece is examined like a mineralogical case, from a distance it reads as a dark field with an even rhythm. In the evening the light comes on from within and the stone catches fire — warm gold and blue and green seams surface from the depth while the black collars stay hollows. A glowing mountain range.
LC0574.whereItWorks: Dining rooms, lobbies, bars, studies, gallery spaces. The texture is visible close up, so the composition is not hung higher than necessary.
LC0574.style: Natural aesthetics and brutal opulence: the mineral as a gem. The message is collectorly — a piece for someone who values substance.
LC0574.madeToOrder: The make-up of the field, the lengths of the rods and the selection of textures are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a principle from which combinations grow. Every module is self-sufficient — one panel works as a wall light. But the real story begins in the assembly: the panels fall into a rhythm, with offsets and pauses, and as in origami one principle gives rise to endless variants.
Rectangular panels with a radial relief read as sheets of paper folded into a fan; at the centre of each is a gold mirrored window.

By day the relief reads through light and shade while the mirrored windows gather the room — the wall works as graphic art. In the evening warm light leaves the windows, the rays of the relief radiate from it, and every panel glows like a small sun behind a blind.
LC0575.whereItWorks: A strict horizontal above a console, a chequerboard order in a stairwell, a continuous light panel in a living room. The layout is chosen for a specific wall.
LC0575.style: Art Deco and modular design: the panel as a unit of composition. The message is architectural — a piece that works with a wall rather than hanging on it.
LC0575.madeToOrder: The number of panels, the layout and the scale are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a sky mixed with a forest. Soft lumps — white and mossy green — read as fragments of a cumulus sky and as fragments of a canopy at the same time. The form is deliberately alive: no sharp corners, no geometry, as though it had grown by itself.
The white ones give purity and air, the green ones nature and calm; some versions add mirrored gold details, like flecks of sun in foliage.

By day it is a calm mass with not one straight line — a piece read through plasticity and the alternation of colour. In the evening light comes out from under the clouds as soft warm patches, lifting the neighbouring elements, and the cloud acquires depth: what burns is not the surface but the gaps.
LC0576.whereItWorks: Bedrooms, living rooms, spa areas, restaurants. It gathers into a dense low cloud or scatters across a ceiling in occasional groups — the format adapts to the room.
LC0576.style: Bio-design and natural minimalism: cloud and moss as paired motifs. The message is calm and natural — a piece for an interior that soothes.
LC0576.madeToOrder: The size and density of the cloud and the balance of white to green are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about how a finish changes the voice of a form. The brand's familiar flagship curl is rendered in a dense glossy finish: the silhouette has become sharper, the form more composed, the plasticity more expressive. In the clear execution this element sounded light and airy; in the opaque white one it sounds substantial and sculptural. One character, two languages.
A fine gold capsule beside every element does not interfere with the form, it emphasises its rhythm.

By day the flock flies in a broad wedge, the gloss catching the reflections of its neighbours, and the composition reads as one movement — dense at the centre, thinned at the edges. In the evening the capsules draw warm verticals between the elements, and the wedge is stitched through with light.
LC0577.whereItWorks: Living rooms, lobbies, dining rooms, stairwells. The wedge has a direction: the composition is oriented along the route from the entrance.
LC0577.style: Contemporary sculpture and Art Deco: the curl as a signature. The message is expressive — a piece for an interior that wants plasticity.
LC0577.madeToOrder: The number of elements, the spread of the flock and the ratio of mass to light are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about cloth that has caught a gust. Vertical sheets bend into free folds, and light from within makes a rigid form look soft — the contradiction the whole piece rests on.

This is a system from which anything can be assembled: a spare accent of five panels or a light architecture the full height of an atrium. There is no single correct shape — there is a logic of growth, as in natural structures.

By day it is a deep burgundy-chocolate beside mirrored gold: a dark register, rare in the world of light, read through folds and reflections. In the evening light comes out of the depth of the folds, slides along the curves and lifts the neighbouring sheets — not white gloss but depth: wine, chocolate, old gold.
LC0578.whereItWorks: Atriums, lobbies, restaurants, private living rooms, stairwells. The dark register requires either a large volume or dark surroundings.
LC0578.style: Dark luxe and contemporary sculpture: drapery in a noble register. The message is adult and deep — a piece for an interior with a mood.
LC0578.madeToOrder: The make-up and the scale are made to order, to the ceiling height and the rhythm of the interior.

paragraphs: A composition about a landscape suspended in air. Crumpled plates of mirrored gold read as a molten flow, white matte elements with live openings as bone or coral, and between them faceted crystals hover. Three geologies in one volume.
Every texture leads its own part: the gold gathers and multiplies reflections, the matte whiteness kills them, the crystals scatter sharp highlights.

By day the piece holds a space even switched off — the layered drama of textures reads anew from every angle. In the evening fine drops of light between the elements come on, the gold goes white-hot with reflections, and the white stays cold: the space turns into a gallery for a single work.
LC0579.whereItWorks: Lobbies, atriums, double-height living rooms, gallery spaces, showrooms. This is no longer a luminaire in the domestic sense — an object sculpture that needs room.
LC0579.style: Contemporary art and brutal opulence: texture instead of form. The message is artistic — a work rather than a furnishing.
LC0579.madeToOrder: The make-up, the scale and the balance of textures are made to order, as a single example.

paragraphs: A composition about a branch lying along the wind. The tubes reach out in horizontal waves, and on them, like buds, sit crystals — the light is drawn out along rather than gathered at a point.
The branches cross at differing heights, forming a light canopy: it takes up almost no volume and gathers the whole space around it.

By day it is the graphic of branches with coloured buds — smoky blue in the gold version, deep green in the chrome one; the bubbled structure reads against the light. In the evening a source lights inside every crystal, the bubbles flare as a constellation, and the bud glows from within — the branch comes into flower in light.
LC0580.whereItWorks: Above a long table, a bar counter, a reception desk — wherever a horizontal is needed. The canopy steals no height and suits medium ceilings.
LC0580.style: Art Nouveau and natural modern: the branch as a classic motif. The message is alive and spring-like — a piece for an interior that loves botany.
LC0580.madeToOrder: The number of branches, their curves, the finish and the colour of the crystals are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a downpour at sunset. The opal surface glows softly from within, without glare: the light seems dissolved in the mass rather than hidden inside it.
Every drop is an independent vertical line with a chrome tip; together they gather into a cloud. The chrome adds graphic quality — cold vertical strokes in a warm haze.

By day it is a pink-and-pearl stream with silver tops: a piece read through the rhythm of the verticals and the softness of the colour. In the evening the opal fills from within with an even glow, the chrome stays cold, and the composition becomes an arrested downpour lit by a sunset.
LC0581.whereItWorks: A dense low stream above a table, a tall thinned cloud in an entrance hall, a cascade in a stairwell — the format is adjusted to the mood of the space.
LC0581.style: Romantic modern and contemporary classic: rain in a warm register. The message is tender — a piece for an interior with a soft palette.
LC0581.madeToOrder: The number of drops, the differences in height and the tone are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a border that does not cut. The divider does not split a space, it separates it into layers: air and light pass through, silhouettes behind it soften, zones are divided without walls.
Vertical polished strings are strung with white lenses: the module repeats, and from the repetition a graphic is born — light, transparent, almost musical.

By day light from the window plays in the lenses as highlights, and the divider lives on reflections while staying almost transparent. In the evening it is lit and becomes a curtain of light — the border appears exactly enough to be seen.
LC0582.whereItWorks: Between a living room and a dining room, a bedroom and a dressing room, in hotel lobbies and restaurants. The transparency gives zoning where a solid wall would be surplus.
LC0582.style: Contemporary minimalism and Art Deco: the module and repetition instead of ornament. The message is calm and architectural — a piece that is a background rather than an accent.
LC0582.madeToOrder: The height, the width, the density and the rhythm of the modules are all made to order, to the opening.

paragraphs: One element of the flock taken in close-up. The contour seems to hold the light inside a given silhouette and keep it from spreading: an unbroken line of gold encloses a clear faceted spindle.
The piece is reduced to a minimum — and the precision of the lines reads more clearly for it than it does in the large composition.

By day, switched off, the wall light remains a jeweller's object on the wall: pure form, faceting, nothing surplus. In the evening the facets gather the rays into a vertical line, the spindle becomes a glowing core, and the gold lights up as a warm contour — the light turns out to be caught in a setting.
LC0583.whereItWorks: Solo beside a bedhead or a mirror, in a pair flanking a portal, in a rhythmic series along a corridor. It also works as a companion to the large LC0584 composition, continuing its plasticity on the wall.
LC0583.style: Art Deco and jewelled Art Nouveau: the setting as a device. The message is spare — a piece for a wall for which one detail is enough.
LC0583.madeToOrder: The size, the finish of the contour and the character of the faceting are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a turn. Every element reads as a maple seed or as a swift in flight: a contour of polished golden tube with a clear faceted wing stretched inside it. Seed and bird have one thing in common — both turn rather than fly straight.
The light here is not gathered into points: it lives in the wings themselves. The flock crosses a space in a wide arc.

By day the composition reassembles from different angles: now a dense shoal, now a thinned scattering of solitary wings. In the evening the facets break the rays, the gold adds warm reflections, and the whole flock shimmers like a current in a shaft of sunlight — movement appears with not one moving part.
LC0584.whereItWorks: Extended spaces — above a long table, along a staircase, in an entrance hall with a high ceiling: anywhere there is room for flight. The trajectory is designed for a specific volume.
LC0584.style: Art Nouveau and contemporary sculpture: flight as a classic motif. The message is dynamic — a piece for a space people move through.
LC0584.madeToOrder: The trajectory of the flock, the number of elements and the spread are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a moment caught in a fold. The plasticity of folded cloth is arrested — every element is a small sculpture in which the folds catch light and shadow.

This is a modular system rather than a chandelier in the usual sense: the elements assemble into a ring, a cascade, an elongated line, a dense volume or an almost airy structure. The composition changes with the angle of view and holds its character every time.

By day the white reads through the plasticity of the folds, the dark elements add contrast and depth, and the gold centre turns every module into a point of attraction in its own right. In the evening the light does not flood the form — it comes out from within, like breathing: a soft accent that emphasises the relief and makes the white warm and the dark velvet.
LC0585.whereItWorks: Living rooms, lobbies, dining rooms, stairwells, reception rooms. The modularity allows the composition to be assembled to any geometry — from a compact ring to an architectural volume.
LC0585.style: Contemporary sculpture and Art Deco: the fold as a module. The message is flexible and expressive — a piece that is built to the space.
LC0585.madeToOrder: The size, the shape, the number of elements and the balance of light to dark are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a joke told in earnest. Driplight repeats the silhouette of a medical drip stand: a polished pole, a fine tube, a control switch and, in place of the infusion bag, a matte shade. The irony is obvious, but the message is serious: support, recovery, an inner reserve — the things a fast pace of life is always short of.

By day it is a sculptural object with a recognisable silhouette: a clean pole, an exact proportion, a piece read through form and quotation. In the evening the Driplight "drips" a soft warm light — the best metaphor for recovery a piece of furniture can permit itself.
For all its conceptual bent this is a fully functional floor lamp: 150–170 cm tall, a stable base, a dimmable 8–12 W source — enough light to read by in the armchair beside it.
LC0586.whereItWorks: Bold interiors, design spaces, the lounge areas of clinics and studios, private living rooms. The piece needs a viewer who gets the quotation.
LC0586.style: Conceptual design and postmodernism: an object as a statement. The message is ironic and humane — a piece for someone who values meaning as much as form.
LC0586.madeToOrder: The height of the pole, the finish and the colour temperature of the light are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about the cable becoming the hero. It is usually hidden — here hundreds of fine cords descend from the ceiling as a dense stream, each ruling the space with a line of its own.
The lower edge is not level: the drops hang at differing heights, forming a relief of light — rain stopped an instant before the ground.

By day it is live graphic work: close up the individual lines of the cords are visible, from a distance a vertical hatching, almost a draft drawing. In the evening the warm points gather into a dense shimmering cloud that does not dazzle but envelops — a waterfall of light with no visible source.
LC0587.whereItWorks: The composition can descend through an entire stairwell or hang low above a table, marking out a zone of light. The length of the cords is unlimited.
LC0587.style: Industrial minimalism and contemporary installation: structure as decor. The message is honest — a piece that does not hide how it is made.
LC0587.madeToOrder: The density of the rain, the area, the differences in height and the number of elements are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a galaxy of one's own. Planets hang in different orbits, elongated golden elements stitch the space between them like rockets on the launch pad, and the whole system opens slowly as you move through the room.
The round elements read as the surfaces of planets: a relief texture with craters and seas, lit around the edge by a fine ring of light.

By day it is a sculptural installation with a play of matte against mirrored: the relief reads through light and shade, the polished bodies catch the room. In the evening the room goes out and only space remains — glowing planet discs, trajectories, stars.
LC0588.whereItWorks: Children's rooms, dark evening interiors, lobbies, stairwells, showrooms. The effect works with subdued ambient light.
LC0588.style: Cosmic modernism and mid-century: the orbit as a motif. The message is fairy-tale and contemporary — a piece for a space that loves stories.
LC0588.madeToOrder: The number of planets and rockets, the diameters and the drop heights are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about topography. The upper and lower contours of the field change smoothly along its whole length — like contour lines on a map, like a mountain ridge or an ocean current. Landscape translated into light, quite literally.
The object lives by its depth: the elements stand in layers of differing density, and from every viewpoint the relief reassembles.

By day it is a dense field of verticals with a live contour: a piece read through silhouette and layers, monumental and quiet. In the evening hundreds of warm points come on inside the field — the lights of settlements on a night slope. The colour sets the geography: amber for dunes and sandstone, blue for currents and glaciers, green for valleys after rain.
LC0589.whereItWorks: Lobbies, atriums, conference halls, panoramic living rooms, gallery spaces. The relief is designed anew for every interior.
LC0589.style: Parametric design and natural aesthetics: the landscape as a form. The message is monumental — a piece that is architecture.
LC0589.madeToOrder: The dimensions of the field, the changes in contour and the density and colour of the elements are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about honey through a comb. The light passes through the modules densely, slowly, enveloping — it does not pour, it seeps. The device is prompted by the form itself: vertical cells standing side by side.

Assembled, the composition recalls a honeycomb, a druse of crystals and a fragment of set rock at once — a natural structure translated into the language of architecture. The frame holds the form and the rhythm, the light-transmitting part the depth and the warmth.

By day it is a strict geometry with clean facets: a piece read through the rhythm of the cells, almost an architectural detail. In the evening an amber glow from within makes it warm and deep — rock with the sun caught inside it.
LC0590.whereItWorks: A compact group works as an accent sculpture above a table; a large assembly as a glowing column filling the vertical of a double-height space.
LC0590.style: Natural architecture and brutal opulence: the cell as a structural module. The message is warm and substantial — a piece for an interior with character.
LC0590.madeToOrder: The number of modules, the height of the assembly and the configuration are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a line drawn in the air. Curved clear tubes join into continuous trajectories — loops, orbits, strokes; every composition becomes a gesture of its own: one lies as a calm wave, another twists into an interlacing of orbits, a third hangs above a table as a calligraphic signature.
This is a long exposure of light, arrested in the frame.

By day it is a transparent sculpture with warm golden joints — a piece read through trajectory and with almost no mass. In the evening the light flows inside the tubes like a current of energy, and pure graphic work remains: the lines are reflected in windows and polished stone, doubling through the space.
LC0591.whereItWorks: From a compact stroke above a table to an installation across a whole hall — living rooms, lobbies, restaurants, showrooms. The drawing is composed for a specific space.
LC0591.style: Contemporary sculptural installation and calligraphic aesthetics: the line as the only material. The message is artistic — a piece that is a gesture.
LC0591.madeToOrder: The trajectory, the scale and the number of tubes are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about cartography. Inside every plate is a labyrinth of relief lines: the veins of a leaf, the meanders of river beds, the contour rings on an old map. Three readings of one drawing, and all three about how terrain is put together.
Elements with a live uneven contour hover in layers: the composition reads differently from every position — now floating leaves, now an archipelago, now the section of a fantastical landform.

By day it is a transparent sculpture in the air: the deep green reads against the light and the drawing is visible in the mass. In the evening light passes through the plates and carries the drawing outward — green shadows and highlights settle on the walls and begin to live as a separate graphic, and the labyrinths of lines turn into a glowing map.
LC0592.whereItWorks: Living rooms, winter gardens, lobbies, restaurants, studies. The coloured shadows on the walls are part of the effect: quiet surfaces are needed nearby.
LC0592.style: Natural modern and cartographic aesthetics: the line as the content. The message is intellectual — a piece for an interior that loves detail.
LC0592.madeToOrder: The shape of the cloud, the number of layers and elements and the tone are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a bouquet in which the light has opened. From the base rises a bundle of golden stems, and on each a pleated parasol unfurls — a form that reads as a giant water-lily pad, as a flower head and as a sea fan.
The parasols stand at differing heights: a bouquet, not a formation.

By day it is fine botany on gold stems: the corrugation reads through light and shade, and the deep green velvet of the base gives the piece weight and warmth. In the evening light comes on in the gold core of every parasol, rays radiate along the folds, and each disc acquires a halo of its own — a soft shadow below, a glowing relief above. A small garden of light beside an armchair.
LC0593.whereItWorks: Beside an armchair, beside a bed, in a private living room, in a boudoir. Several blooms at differing heights replace both a floor lamp and a night light — the light is adjusted by tilting the parasols.
LC0593.style: Art Nouveau and contemporary classic: botany with velvet and gilding. The message is intimate and warm — a piece for a private space.
LC0593.madeToOrder: The number and tilt of the parasols, the finish of the stems and the colour of the base are all made to order.

paragraphs: The same bouquet, opened wider. The umbrellas are spread across the height and turned in different directions — each catches its own angle, and the vertical stops being a stand with lights on top: it becomes a plant reaching several ways at once.
The spread of tilts gives the piece movement: from one point it is a dense crown, from another a sparse branch.

By day it is fine botany at full height: the pleating reads as hatching, the golden stems draw the vertical, the piece is light and tall. In the evening each disc lights up separately and gains a halo of its own — the lamp gives not one circle of light but several small ones, at different heights. A garden standing beside the armchair.
LC0593-1.whereItWorks: The corner of a sitting room, the zone by a window, a bedroom, a reception room. Umbrellas facing different ways let the light be tuned to the task: some down for reading, some up for atmosphere.
LC0593-1.style: Art Nouveau and organic modernism: growth as the principle of form. The message is warm and alive — a piece for an interior that loves nature.
LC0593-1.madeToOrder: The height of the stand, the number of umbrellas and the spread of heights and tilts are all made to order.

paragraphs: The same bouquet, gathered more quietly. The umbrellas stand closer together and almost at one level — not a scattered inflorescence but a dense head from which the light comes out in a single broad pool. The change in spacing between the discs changes the whole character of the piece: there it was a garden, here it is one flower.
The stems rise from the base in a strict bunch, and the vertical reads cleaner than in the loose version.

By day it is graphic work in pleated discs on golden stems: the relief is read through light and shade, the silhouette is compact and spare. In the evening light from the cores runs out along the folds and gathers into one shared glow — the lamp gives not a scatter of haloes but an even warm circle beside the armchair.
LC0593-2.whereItWorks: Beside a reading chair, at a bedhead, in a study, in a private sitting room. The dense head throws its light in a single gather: the piece works not only as an image but as a working source.
LC0593-2.style: Art Nouveau and contemporary classic: botany in a restrained reading. The message is intimate — a piece for an interior that has no need to raise its voice.
LC0593-2.madeToOrder: The height of the stand, the number and tilt of the umbrellas and the finish of the stems are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about reversed roles. By day it is a sculptural panel: a play of relief, matte surface and mirrored facets in which the white discs lead, with a deep carving radiating from the centre like the petals of a chrysanthemum. In the evening the roles change: the faceted ones flare with gold haloes, the matte ones recede into soft chiaroscuro, and the wall turns into a night sky with suns in it.
Round elements in two diameters gather on a wall as a free constellation — a scattering rather than a grid.
LC0594.whereItWorks: From a strict pair above a console to a field scattered up the full height of a double-height wall — entrance halls, living rooms, stair landings, reception desks. The layout of the constellation is chosen for a specific wall.
LC0594.style: Art Deco and contemporary sculpture: the disc as a module. The message is decorative and flexible — a piece that adapts to any wall.
LC0594.madeToOrder: The number of elements, their combination and the dimensions of the panel are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a dialogue between the wild and the perfect. The base is an unworked black stone with chipped facets, but on its cut face a honeycomb pattern is carved: as though the rock had begun turning into ornament by itself. Above the stone, at an angle, sits a disc with the same relief.
The pattern of the stone picks up the pattern of the disc: the unworked and the perfect turn out to share one nature. Every object is unique — the stone of the base is never repeated.

By day it is a sculpture on a table: the relief reads through light and shade, the chips of the stone through texture, a tactile and complex piece. In the evening light is born at the golden centre and spreads through the cells: the matte disc glows evenly, like a moon; the faceted one breaks the light into hundreds of highlights. A pair is especially expressive — a matte one and a clear one side by side.
LC0595.whereItWorks: A console, a mantelpiece, a bedside table, a desk. The compact format (300 × 220 mm, 440 mm tall) gathers a surface around it without needing any ceiling space.
LC0595.style: Wabi-sabi and natural minimalism: the fracture and the ornament in one piece. The message is contemplative — a piece for the inner circle.
LC0595.madeToOrder: The execution of the disc, the character of the stone and the finish of the centre are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a quiet dialogue. Discs of two characters — matte white with radial pleating and clear with a faceted radial drawing — hold a conversation in which neither shouts the other down.
At the centre of each is a golden accent that gathers the disc the way a button gathers cloth.

By day the composition works through texture: relief, facets, the warm glimmer of the cores; the cloud opens slowly as you walk around it — behind a matte disc a clear one flares, and behind that another matte one. In the evening the roles diverge: the matte ones hold a soft shadow, the clear ones light from within, and the cloud shimmers like a bloom of jellyfish in dark water.
LC0596.whereItWorks: Living rooms, dining rooms, spa areas, meeting rooms, lobbies. The layering reads from below and from the side: the composition is not hung higher than necessary.
LC0596.style: Contemporary classic and marine modern: the disc as a pure form. The message is calm — a piece for an interior that loves a nuance.
LC0596.madeToOrder: The size, the density and the ratio of matte to clear discs are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about the elements. A soft undulating lower edge makes the silhouette alive: at the bottom the composition does not break off, it runs down — banners in the wind, weed in the body of water, an aurora arrested in a room.
Plates of two characters, matte white and clear coloured, descend from the ceiling on fine cables; above them a scattering of miniature points holds the curtain in the air, like stars.

By day, as you move through the room, the layers reassemble and the drawing never repeats: in a cold register it is ice and turquoise, in a deep green one a dark field with a gold reverse. In the evening the points above light up, and the green version becomes an evening forest with the sun burning deep inside it, the cold one a radiance over water.
LC0597.whereItWorks: Lobbies, atriums, double-height living rooms, stairwells, restaurants. Related to the LC0598 series: the same plates, a different character — a city there, the elements here.
LC0597.style: Contemporary sculptural installation and natural modern: the curtain as a form. The message is atmospheric — a piece that changes the state of a space.
LC0597.madeToOrder: The dimensions, the density, the palette and the drawing of the lower edge are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about an evening horizon. Hundreds of narrow plates on cables of differing length form the silhouette of a city: setbacks, towers, gaps, light in the windows. Inside each is a matte drawing, as though branches or currents had set in the mass.
The composition never looks the same twice: as you move around it the plates reassemble — a dense wall from one position, transparent lacework from another.

By day it is the graphic of silhouettes read through overlay and inner drawing; the same form in emerald, crystal white and amber sounds like a northern forest, a winter city or a sunset. In the evening points of warm light scatter between the plates like lights in windows, and the horizon catches fire.
LC0598.whereItWorks: A cascade above a living room, an extended wave along a staircase, a dense cloud in an entrance hall. The shape is assembled for the space and reads from a distance.
LC0598.style: Urban modernism and contemporary sculpture: the city as a motif. The message is narrative — a piece that sets the mood of a whole room.
LC0598.madeToOrder: The size and shape of the composition and the number and colour of the elements are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a stained-glass window taken out of a wall. The engraving repeats the architecture of old cathedrals: lancet windows, openwork façades, round rose windows, spires reaching upward. Every plate is a window released into the air.
Elements in four heights are composed freely: a dense vertical cascade, a horizontal field beneath the ceiling, or a gallery of hovering windows along a wall.

By day it is graphic work — a fine engraved drawing on a clear field, read against the light. In the evening a point of light above every plate passes through the engraving and the drawing begins to glow from within: an architecture of light, a city of cathedrals suspended in the air.
LC0599.whereItWorks: Spaces with high ceilings, stairwells, lofts, lobbies — wherever light should tell a story. The plates are produced in amber-gold, deep turquoise or graphite-clear — from warm intimacy to Gothic coolness.
LC0599.style: Gothic in a contemporary reading and Art Deco: architectural ornament kept from the literal. The message is narrative — a piece for an interior that loves meaning.
LC0599.madeToOrder: The number of plates, the drop heights and the tone are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition in two layers. The first is the hemispheres themselves with their engraved coral pattern: branching, cellular, radial structures, no two drawings alike. The second is the shadow: under a point source the engraving throws a second, shadow composition onto the wall and ceiling, and the drawing begins to live apart from the object.
The convex surface holds the pattern in three dimensions, and it reads differently from every position.

By day it is graphic art turned object: clear, powdery pink, blue, turquoise and smoky bronze hemispheres with the finest white line — an oceanic collection gathered not in an album but in space. In the evening the second layer comes on, and a shadow repeating the pattern appears on the wall — the object doubles.
LC0600.whereItWorks: An intimate group above a console or a continuous coral field across a whole wall; on a ceiling the composition opens like a flowering above water — in spa areas and beside a pool it is reflected and doubles once more.
LC0600.style: Marine modern and the graphic school: the drawing as the content. The message is collectorly — a piece for an interior that is examined.
LC0600.madeToOrder: The make-up of the hemispheres, their diameters and their tones are all made to order.

paragraphs: A composition about a flock at dawn. The birds are lit from below — the way they look at the hour when the sun is still under the horizon and the light comes from the ground rather than the sky. That one device sets the whole time of day inside the piece.

Every figure is cast at a moment of movement: spread wings with plumage in relief, a body that has caught a rising current. There is no prescribed scheme — the birds line up in a wedge, scatter into a free flock, rise in a spiral or draw out into a train.

By day it is a sculpture in the air: a white matte finish and warm golden metal keep the composition in a noble, calm register, and the piece reads through the plasticity of the plumage. In the evening the sources under the wings come on and the flock carries the light — a dawn that arrives on schedule.
LC0601.whereItWorks: Double-height living rooms, staircases, hotel lobbies, galleries. The same series becomes an intimate group above a table or an installation tens of metres long.
LC0601.style: Art Nouveau and contemporary sculpture: flight as a classic motif. The message is poetic — a piece that stops a moment.
LC0601.madeToOrder: The number of birds, the trajectory of the flight and the height and direction of each are all made to order.

paragraphs: The same flock in a floor format. Around a vertical pole the birds circle in a rising spiral, and the eye reads the movement from the bottom up: the flock takes off and the light rises with it.
The light here is not a function but company: it stands beside you like something alive.

By day the floor lamp works as a sculpture: the fine plasticity of the plumage, a clean golden vertical, the rhythm of the wings. In the evening it works as a source of soft, living light that does not flood but is scattered along the silhouette, like windows at dusk.
LC0602.whereItWorks: A living room, a bedroom, a study, a reception room. It is an independent object and at the same time a continuation of the LC0601 series: a suspended flock beneath the ceiling and a rising flock beside an armchair gather a space into one story.
LC0602.style: Art Nouveau and contemporary sculpture: the vertical as a trajectory of take-off. The message is lyrical — a piece for an interior that loves stories.
LC0602.madeToOrder: The number of birds, their placement on the pole and the finish are all made to order.
